page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highcpu-32 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the n4d server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a resource ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, which is tailored for compute-intensive workloads that do not require large memory footprints.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external block storage options. Additionally, the n4d-highcpu-32 does not feature any GPU accelerators, relying entirely on its dedicated x86_64 CPU cores for processing. The instance also comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external network configuration or NAT gateways for public internet connectivity.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high vCPU-to-RAM ratio of the n4d-highcpu-32 allows organizations to scale processing power without paying for unneeded memory capacity. This resource density makes the instance suitable for CPU-bound tasks such as batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
